\tadvancement.arcanearchives.amphora.des: Craft a Radiant Amphora for easy fluid transfer with tanks.

\tadvancement.arcanearchives.containment: Craft a Containment Field as a Tank's second upgrade.

\tadvancement.arcanearchives.trove.desc: Craft a Radiant Trove in a Gem Cutter's Table. Store all of a thing!
